verdicts.V1: V1: THE PROTOCOL IS COMPLETE -- per-bin ESD extraction of gammat(theta)/DeltaSigma(R) in 5 log bins over [0.03, 0.1] R500 (theta = 0.4-1.4 arcmin), slope p = d ln DeltaSigma/d ln R = s + 1 by weighted log-log OLS, with the HST-class PSF-smear residual floor and the source-redshift dilution corrections (Sigma_crit^-1 weighting, z_pdf, member contamination f_cont, magnification); the strong lensing (arcs at r_E = 20-60 kpc INSIDE the window; systems to ~2 r_E) anchors the inner bins at epsilon_SL = 3%.  PREDICTED SEPARATION at the expected HST-class precision: per-cluster slope error sigma_p = 0.355 (median, WITH the SL anchor; the registered budget is 0.167; the no-arcs shape-noise floor is 2.838); the registered kill pair (-1.5 vs -1) separates at 6.7 sigma pooled over the 5-cluster Tier-1 sample (8.9 sigma over all 12) with the SL anchor, and at 0.5 / 0.7 sigma without; the window-honest pair (-1.5 vs the committed-rs NFW effective s ~ -1.03) at 28.9 sigma (Tier-1) / 46.2 sigma (all 12).
verdicts.V2: V2: THE TARGET LIST -- Tier 1 (the D2 cores, existing published shear VERIFIED in-repo via L24): A2142 (Subaru SC Umetsu+09/Okabe&Umetsu+08 + Herbonnet+20), A2029 (HSC spec-tomo Dell'Antonio+19 + CFHT + Herbonnet+20), ZW1215 (Subaru Kubo+09 + Herbonnet+20), A85 (HSC inner map Kim+25 + Herbonnet+20), A1795 (Herbonnet+20).  Tier 2 (no published shear; new wide-field needed too; largest theta_E = A3266, 37 arcsec): A3266, A2319, A2255, A3158, A644, A1644, RXC1825.  ALL 12: HST archive claims for the inner strong-lensing core are UNVERIFIED (0/12 have a published CLASH/HFF/A1689-class SL core); the arcs at 20-60 kpc are PREDICTED (G136), not yet observed -- the inner half of the window needs NEW deep HST imaging (~CLASH-class depth) on the Tier-1 targets.
verdicts.V3: V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the D2 verdict's instrument path is now concrete: the measurement that decides NFW vs the theory is the residual lensing core at r < 0.1 R500, planned as (i) the 5-bin [0.03, 0.1] R500 ESD profile with slope p = s + 1 at the projected precision sigma_p = 0.355 (per cluster, median, WITH the SL anchor; 2.838 without -- the arcs are the difference), (ii) the separation 6.7 sigma (Tier-1 pooled) for the registered -1-vs-1.5 pair and 46.2 sigma for the window-honest pair over the full 12, both WITH the anchor (the no-arcs floor is 0.5 / 1.5 sigma -- pooled-only, below the decision rule) -- the instrument CAN decide D2 IF the predicted arcs materialize; (iii) the existing-archive floor: 5/12 have published shear (VERIFIED in-repo), 0/12 have a verified inner HST strong-lensing core, so the inner half of the window needs NEW deep HST imaging (~CLASH-class depth, 5 targets) or verified archival exposures that neither this repo nor the published SL literature can attest today => D2 REMAINS UNDECIDED at this repository's standards until those cores are observed, exactly the state G096 (V3) and G136 registered; this lane turns that open item into a scheduled measurement with a decision rule, not a hope.
